name: High Priestess Mar'li
notes: Numbers follow docs/research/zul-gurub/marli.md: Era 333,125 HP, 20-man, modelled as five 60 s phases: three troll forms and two spider forms. Cadences for Poison Bolt Volley, Corrosive Poison, Poison Shock and Drain Life are estimates; the research only pins the 60 s form cycle. No enrage. Tentonhammer's single spider form at 90% is treated as obsolete. Boss melee (280 per 2 s) is scaled so a 10,000 HP tank survives normal play and dies if the healer ignores a spike. Tank model: a real raid has two tanks, one on her and one waiting with the ranged group. Here you play both in turn. In troll form you are on her; when she shifts, Webs stun the melee, she Charges the ranged group (`teleportBossTo`) and the game moves you to the fresh tank's spot among the ranged (`teleportTankTo`), then the table is wiped: Taunt and walk her back to the boss spot. Melee are stunned for the full 8 s of Webs (the real root, silence and -100% attack speed leave them with nothing to do). Her charge is a teleport; the real one is a run-in. Tanks are not webbed here, because the sim has one tank player and a webbed tank could not answer the Charge. Spiders are `adds` killFirst with a short lifetime: the real ones grow every 4 s and become CC-immune and deadly after 20 s, which the engine cannot show, so killing them fast is scored instead. Witherbark Speaker is not modelled (the raid Mind Controls or sheeps it away at the pull). Enlarge (DBM warns to dispel it off the Spawn) is a Magic debuff proxy on the raid in troll form, the same stand-in as Venoxis's Renew, with an estimated cadence. Spawn poison and Thrash are not modelled. Drain Life is a 3 s interruptible cast (the channel's opening) that, if it finishes, leaves a 7 s Magic debuff ticking 500 per second on a random player; she heals herself 25x in the real fight, which the fixed HP clock cannot show, so a completed cast is scored against the interrupters. Poison Bolt Volley is an `aoe` with a 30 yd radius measured from her edge, plus a Poison debuff that lands on tanks and melee; ranged and healers are assumed to stand beyond 30 yd (their spots are 30 to 34 yd from her), and their attack range is 36 yd (talented casters and hunters). The real fight also lets you dodge the volley entirely by range; here standing inside 30 yd costs you the hit and is scored.

tank.label: Main tank
tank.description: Hold her at the boss spot in troll form. Every time she shifts to spider form the table wipes: the fresh tank waiting with the ranged group, played by you, Taunts her the moment she lands and walks her back.

melee.label: Melee DPS
melee.description: Kill the spiders that hatch, then stay on her. Interrupt Drain Life. When you are webbed, wait: do not run after her.

ranged.label: Ranged DPS
ranged.description: Stand over 30 yd from her, outside Poison Bolt Volley. Kill spiders first, interrupt Drain Life, and stop at each shift until the fresh tank has her.

healer.label: Healer
healer.description: Stand over 30 yd out with the ranged. Cleanse Poison Bolt Volley and Corrosive Poison off tanks and melee, dispel Drain Life if it lands, and keep both tanks healed through each shift.

taunt.label: Taunt
taunt.tip: Taunt forces the boss onto you for a few seconds and puts you on top of the threat table. Press it the moment the boss turns on the raid, never while it is already on you.

attack.label: Attack
attack.tip: Attacks generate threat. Stop when the threat bar turns red so the boss stays on the tank.

heal.label: Heal the tank
heal.tip: A large heal for the tank. Time it to land with the incoming damage.

dispel.label: Dispel
dispel.tip: Removes the oldest dispellable debuff on the raid. One button here stands in for Dispel Magic, Cleanse, Decurse and Cure Poison.

interrupt.label: Interrupt
interrupt.tip: Drain Life heals her for 25 times what she takes. Stop every one you can reach. Kick, Pummel, Earth Shock, Counterspell.

drainLife.label: Drain Life
drainLife.tip: She channels Drain Life on a random player for 7 s, 500 a second, healing herself 25 times that. Interrupt it, and dispel it if it lands.

poisonVolley.label: Poison Bolt Volley
poisonVolley.tip: Everyone within 30 yd takes 375 and a Poison DoT of 289 every 2 s for 10 s. Ranged and healers stand beyond it.

volleyPoison.label: Volley poison
volleyPoison.tip: The DoT from Poison Bolt Volley. Healers cleanse it from tanks and melee.

spiders.label: Spawn of Mar'li
spiders.tip: Four spiders hatch at the pull, and more later. They grow every few seconds and are CC-immune after 20 s. Kill them first.

enlarge.label: Enlarge
enlarge.tip: She enlarges a Spawn: Magic. Dispel it the moment it lands.

spiderPair.label: Spawn of Mar'li
spiderPair.tip: More spiders hatch. Kill them before you touch her.

envelopingWebs.label: Enveloping Webs
envelopingWebs.tip: As she shifts to spider form she webs everyone near her: rooted, silenced, and unable to swing for 8 s. Melee: wait, do not run after her.

charge.label: Charge
charge.tip: A second after the webs she Charges into the ranged group. The fresh tank is waiting there.

phaseWipe.label: Spider Form: threat reset
phaseWipe.tip: The table wipes. DPS stop until the fresh tank has her back.

corrosivePoison.label: Corrosive Poison
corrosivePoison.tip: A big Poison DoT on the tank that also cuts their armor by 5,000. Cleanse it first.

poisonShock.label: Poison Shock
poisonShock.tip: Spider form: 875 Nature to anyone within 10 yd of her.

expectations.label: Pull her to the boss spot
expectations.tip: Taunt her and walk her north to her spot, with the melee group behind her.

expectations.label: Kill the spiders first
expectations.tip: They grow fast and are immune to crowd control after 20 s.

expectations.label: Interrupt every Drain Life
expectations.tip: A Drain Life that lands is 12,500 a second healed on her. Stop it.

expectations.label: Never pull aggro off the tank
expectations.tip: Stop attacking while the threat bar is red. Resume when it leaves the red band.

expectations.label: Stay over 30 yd from her
expectations.tip: Poison Bolt Volley has a 30 yd radius. Beyond that you never take it.

expectations.label: Cure the volley poison
expectations.tip: Tanks and melee first: 289 every 2 s adds up.

expectations.label: Dispel Enlarge
expectations.tip: Magic. Dispel it the moment it lands on a Spawn.

expectations.label: Keep the tank alive
expectations.tip: Volley poison and her melee together are the bulk of the damage.

expectations.label: Keep the tank above half
expectations.tip: Keep the tank topped before the next shift.

expectations.label: Fresh tank: Taunt her on the landing
expectations.tip: She has just landed in the ranged group and the table is empty. Taunt, then walk her back.

expectations.label: Walk her back to her spot
expectations.tip: Do not fight her among the ranged. Walk her back to the boss spot.

expectations.label: Never pull aggro off the tank
expectations.tip: Stop attacking while the threat bar is red. Resume when it leaves the red band.

expectations.label: Cleanse Corrosive Poison
expectations.tip: Tank first. The armor loss is what kills them.

expectations.label: Keep the tank alive
expectations.tip: The fresh tank starts at zero threat and cold heals. Have one landing as she arrives.

expectations.label: Keep the tank above half
expectations.tip: Spider form hits harder and poisons stack on the tank.

expectations.label: Kill the new spiders first
expectations.tip: They are small now. In 20 s they will not be.

expectations.label: Interrupt every Drain Life
expectations.tip: Do not let this one through either.

expectations.label: Never pull aggro off the tank
expectations.tip: Stop attacking while the threat bar is red. Resume when it leaves the red band.

expectations.label: Stay over 30 yd from her
expectations.tip: Melee only take this volley. Keep your distance.

expectations.label: Cure the volley poison
expectations.tip: Tanks and melee first.

expectations.label: Dispel Enlarge
expectations.tip: Magic. Dispel it the moment it lands on a Spawn.

expectations.label: Keep the tank alive
expectations.tip: Keep the tank topped before the next shift.

expectations.label: Keep the tank above half
expectations.tip: The next form change is coming.

expectations.label: Fresh tank: Taunt her on the landing
expectations.tip: Second shift. Same job: Taunt on the landing, walk her back.

expectations.label: Walk her back to her spot
expectations.tip: Back to the boss spot, facing away from the raid.

expectations.label: Never pull aggro off the tank
expectations.tip: Stop attacking while the threat bar is red. Resume when it leaves the red band.

expectations.label: Cleanse Corrosive Poison
expectations.tip: Tank first.

expectations.label: Keep the tank alive
expectations.tip: Expect the spike as she lands on the fresh tank.

expectations.label: Keep the tank above half
expectations.tip: Do not let the tank drift low before the last troll form.

expectations.label: Spiders first, even now
expectations.tip: Finish the spiders, then finish her.

expectations.label: Interrupt every Drain Life
expectations.tip: The last one is the one that costs you the kill.

expectations.label: Never pull aggro off the tank
expectations.tip: Stop attacking while the threat bar is red. Resume when it leaves the red band.

expectations.label: Stay over 30 yd from her
expectations.tip: Do not creep in at the end.

expectations.label: Cure the volley poison
expectations.tip: Tanks and melee first.

expectations.label: Dispel Enlarge
expectations.tip: Magic. Dispel it the moment it lands on a Spawn.

expectations.label: Keep the tank alive
expectations.tip: Keep the tank up until she falls.

expectations.label: Keep the tank above half
expectations.tip: Finish strong: never let the tank sit low.

threatLostCount.label: Times the boss turned on the raid

aggroPulls.label: Times you pulled aggro
aggroPulls.tip: Stop attacking when the threat bar turns red.

attacksInRed.label: Attacks in the red band
attacksInRed.tip: Stop attacking in the red band so the tank can regain a threat lead.

earlyAttacks.label: Attacks before the tank had the boss
earlyAttacks.tip: Give the tank a few seconds after the pull.

dpsIdle.label: Seconds not attacking when you could
dpsIdle.tip: Keep attacking when it's safe. Stop if the threat bar turns red or the boss leaves the tank.

playerInHazard.label: Seconds standing in something bad
playerInHazard.tip: Move out of the ground effect before attacking again.

tankLowSeconds.label: Seconds with the tank under half
tankLowSeconds.tip: Top the tank up before the spike lands, not after.

overheals.label: Wasted heals
overheals.tip: Avoid healing the tank at full health. Save the heal for incoming damage.

debuffSeconds.label: Seconds with a dispellable debuff up

attacksOffPriority.label: Boss attacks while a priority add was alive
attacksOffPriority.tip: Face the add and kill it first. The boss can wait.

volleyHits.label: Poison Bolt Volleys you stood in

cues.notes: Taunt the moment she lands, Interrupt Drain Life, Dispel the poisons, Heal.

list.label: Taunt when Mar'li turns on the raid
list.tip: Taunt as soon as the boss turns toward the raid.

list.label: Heal the tank when they drop low
list.tip: The tank is below half health and a big hit is coming. Heal now.

list.label: Interrupt Drain Life
list.tip: A 3 s Drain Life has started. Interrupt inside the cast.

list.label: Dispel it
list.tip: Dispel the moment it lands. Tank first, then healers, then everyone else.

drills.name: Shift and Charge
drills.description: Already on her. Every 18 s she shifts, webs and Charges: Taunt the moment she lands, then walk her back.

drills.name: Drain Life interrupts
drills.description: Interrupt every Drain Life while managing your threat.

drills.name: Poison routine
drills.description: Volley poison and Corrosive Poison keep coming. Cure them, tank first, and keep the tank up.

limitations: Spider form and its threat reset are scripted. Spider growth and independent add attacks are missing.
